registered_before: any feature-group phase B number (score dump, replay outcome, budget or bootstrap) existed
change: adds a second, independent normal holdout; nothing of v1 is changed or dropped

second_holdout.normal: pulse-live-recalibrated normal 19/10 13:00 - capture end, incident 18:25-19:20 and both campaigns (+-60 s) removed; first 42 % as calibration, the rest for alert burden (as baseline-evaluation-v1)
second_holdout.capture: local copy /var/tmp/pulse-live-copy on .234 (read without NFS load during the live run)
second_holdout.attacks: pulse-live-recalibrated main + follow-up campaigns (1238 paired trials), as v1

how_results_combine: v1 rules are applied on each holdout separately. A component keeps its v1 verdict only if the second holdout does not contradict it ('needed' on one and 'removable' on the other => reported as inconclusive). The second holdout alone never changes the feature set.
why: the v1 holdout (syscall-arms, 48 h soak) can only be read after the live run; the second holdout gives an earlier and independent replication on a later capture with benign-launch controls
evidence_class: development: pulse-live-recalibrated was used to choose earlier Pulse candidates
